title: Pokemon TCG Mienfoo Paradox Rift 096/182 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Pokémon TCG card features Mienfoo, a Fighting type Pokémon with a card number of 096/182 in the Paradox Rift set. The card has a reverse holo finish and is a common card. It is perfect for collectors and players of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. Add this card to your collection or use it to strengthen your deck.
